run_supervised_training: run supervised cross-lingual embedding alignment using Procrustes Iterative Learning with source and target embeddings
build_dictionary: build a bilingual dictionary from aligned embeddings using the CSLS KNN method for refinement iterations
apply_procrustes: apply the orthogonal Procrustes solution to align source and target embedding spaces
evaluate_embeddings: evaluate cross-lingual embedding quality using precision at 1 and mean cosine similarity metrics
export_embeddings: export the best aligned embeddings to a text file or PyTorch checkpoint after training completes
